tagline.en: What if your favorite anime, comic and game songs were born in a late-night jazz club?
tagline.zh: 如果你喜欢的动画、漫画与游戏歌曲，诞生在一家深夜爵士酒吧里？

about.en: If? ACG in Jazz is a cover project that reimagines ACG songs as jazz — swing, bossa nova, ballads and everything in between.
about.zh: If? ACG in Jazz 是一个翻奏计划：把 ACG 歌曲重新编排成爵士——摇摆、波萨诺瓦、抒情曲，以及介于其间的一切。

disclaimer.en: All original songs belong to their respective composers, lyricists and rights holders. These are non-commercial fan covers.
disclaimer.zh: 所有原曲版权归原作曲、作词及版权方所有。本站作品为非商业性质的爱好者翻奏。

statement.en: Anime, comic & game themes, re-voiced in jazz
statement.zh: 把动画、漫画与游戏的旋律，重写成爵士

title.zh: 第一辑 · 午夜信号（示例）

description.en: A demo album so you can see the layout. Replace or delete it in Edit.
description.zh: 示例专辑，用来预览版面效果。可在“编辑”中替换或删除。

about.en: Example notes: arrangement ideas, recording story, instruments used… This is what opens when a listener clicks the song.
about.zh: 示例介绍：编曲思路、录音故事、使用的乐器……听众点击歌曲时会打开这里。
